sql:
SELECT
    count() AS first_bought_in_2007,
    countIf(bought_2008 = 1) AS came_back_in_2008,
    countIf(bought_2008 = 1 AND bought_2009 = 1) AS came_back_again_in_2009
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(toYear(DateKey)) AS first_purchase_year,
        max(toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS bought_2008,
        max(toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS bought_2009
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
WHERE first_purchase_year = 2007
